text: The latest version of `laravel/framework` is **v13.34.0**, released on **September 29, 2026, at 12:48 UTC** [1]. This release is designated as the "Latest" on the official GitHub repository for the framework. Laravel follows Semantic Versioning, with major framework releases occurring annually, typically around Q1, while minor and patch releases are issued more frequently, sometimes weekly, without introducing breaking changes [2]. The current major version, Laravel 13, was initially released on March 17, 2026 [2][3].
